display.summary: ScanLink stress fixes: single scan submission and clear guidance after a lost response.
highlights: Send each scan request once on a healthy transport; a lost response never triggers another scanner request.
Shared English and Arabic recovery guidance covers uncertain scan requests in file fields and the PDF editor.
Paired ScanLink 0.8.0b1 fixes PDF completion, parent deadlines, malformed requests and result download races.
Includes automatic workstation HTTPS setup and the document OCR features from DjangoLux 1.15.
